Upgrade SQLAlchemy 1.4 to 2.0 across Ledgerly models without regressions.

Use `DeclarativeBase`; migrate deprecated `.query.get()` to `session.get()`. Preserve `expire_on_commit=True`. Billing now receives an injected session to avoid hidden transaction boundaries.
